'''What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing''' is the third act in [[Chapter II]] of the [[Main Quests|Main Quest]].

#Find a way out of the mist
#Investigate the “Golden Phantom”
#Continue following the “Golden Phantom”
#Investigate the Pilgrim's Sail
#Defeat the TDs
#Find the source of the sound in the mist
#Head to the Dragon of Dirge Territory
##(Optional) Get there by grappling onto a Wingray

#Meet Up With the Troupe
##(Optional) Get there by grappling onto a Wingray

#Get into shooting position

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing the step "Defeat the Dragon of Dirge" will award the player the ''[[Rover's Journey II]]'' [[trophy]] ''[[Total Recollection]]''.
* During the step "Collect the Cloudcaster components", talking to [[Levito]] will award the player {{Item|Cloudcaster's Base}}, talking to [[Tina]] will award the player {{Item|Cloudcaster's Resonance Unit}}, and talking to [[Battier]] will award the player {{Item|Cloudcaster's Handle}}.
* Completing the step "Invite Carlotta for the rehearsal" will award the player the ''[[Rover's Journey II]]'' trophies ''[[Every Day on Which We Have Not Danced]]'' and ''[[A Rover Prepares]]''.
* Completing the step "Go to Masked Reverie" will award the player [[Unfettered Dove through Day and Night]].
* Completing the step "Defeat Hecate" will award the player {{Item|Perfect Curtain Call}}.
* Completing the step "Investigate the trace left by the mysterious girl" will award the player the ''[[Rover's Journey II]]'' trophy ''[[The Greatest Show]]''.
* Completing the step "Go to the Cathedral of Mercury" will award the player the ''[[Rover's Journey II]]'' trophy ''[[The Answer Is Driftin' on the Sea]]''.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_20.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Long ago, this place was a sacred spot for the Order's pilgrims. Then the Dark Tide hit, and all those Reverberations left behind twisted things up.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_21.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' The Remnant Clouds from the sea of clouds drew hordes of Tacet Discords here. Now, their whispers fill the air, turning this once holy place of pilgrimage into the "Penitent's End."
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_22.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' This "Dragon of Dirge," is a local Tacet Discord. It grows by feeding on the others.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_23.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' We were supposed to pick you up like Ms. Carlotta planned, but... things went sideways.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_24.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' The truth Ms. Carlotta wants to show you lies somewhere on the isle.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_25.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' But this is not the best place to talk. The mist is thickening... and rain is coming.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_26.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' The mist is dangerous here. It traps Reverberations, and when it collects enough, they quickly form into Tacet Discords.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_27.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' The Captain—I mean Brant... He went into the mist to rescue people, but he hasn't returned. We think he might be in danger.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_28.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' I plan to go find him. Once I'm in the mist, my frequency will draw the creepies and crawlies away, so you'll be safer here.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_29.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Just in case, take this to mask your frequency and defend yourself.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_30.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Ta-da! Fireworks Pistol! One shot, and it'll send the Tacet Discords packing.
:{{DIcon}} I like it!
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_34.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' It's easy to use. You want to see the upgraded version? Ta-da! Magnum Fireworks Pistol!
:{{DIcon}} Seems kind of basic...
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_35.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Not your style? I have more where that came from... Ta-da! Celebratory Fireworks Bomb. Wait, that's meant for our dinner. Oops, sorry, Pero grabbed the wrong one. Though, at a pinch, it might prove useful...
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, but guns aren't my thing.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_36.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Alright, try this instead... Ta-da! Captain's Parley Saber!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_37.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Use it to protect yourself. Our troupe will bring you to our base soon and tell you the truth we've uncovered. I'll join you once I find Brant.

::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_41.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' But the mist is dangerous...
:{{DIcon}} I can hold my own in a fight.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_42.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' No, that's not what I meant. Just... this is going to be risky.
:{{DIcon}} I can't let a child do this alone.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_43.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Don't worry. I know this place inside out. For a first-timer, though, it might be a bit much.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_44.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Alright, fine. It's better you see it for yourself. I'll be glad you don't have to fend for yourself alone.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_15_45.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' See that lighthouse? It's the only safe place in the mist. We'll head there. Brant might have taken shelter there, too.

:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_17.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Golden phantoms are... Reverberations mixed with the frequencies left behind by people who've passed away.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_18.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' When someone dies, their Reverberations linger. Usually, they merge into the same cacophony of frequencies that spawns Tacet Discords.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_19.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' But sometimes, a trace of their final will remains, and the mist shapes this into phantoms.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_20.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' This lingering will helps the phantoms resist becoming Tacet Discords and instead guide the lost through the mist.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_21.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' If the mist clears, they'll vanish. If the mist lingers, their fate is sealed. It will only be a matter of time before they merge with other Reverberations and become Tacet Discords.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_22.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Their final frequencies tend to cling to certain objects... like this Luceanite here. I collect them as proof that they once lived.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_23.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Otherwise... the dragon will devour every last trace of their frequency.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_20_24.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' The mist is thinning. That stranded ship ahead looks like...

:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_21_2.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' In Ragunna, those who break the law are sent to the Order Tribunal for sentencing. Those who violate the sacred doctrines are branded as Fools and sent away on the Pilgrim's Sail.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_21_12.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' It's said that when the first Dark Tide ravaged Rinascita, the first Primus followed the currents on a rickety boat and met the Sentinel in person. That's where the Pilgrim's Sail tradition came from.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_21_3.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Now, the Fools retrace the Primus's journey, reflecting on their mistakes along the way.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_21_4.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' There's a strong undercurrent around this isle, likely caused by that first Dark Tide. It drags all Pilgrim's Sails here unless the ship's course is altered.

:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_1.ogg}} '''Brant:''' The show's over, ghosts! Time to take your final bow!
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_2.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Watch your back.

:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_8_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_8_F.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' {{MC|m=He|f=She}} was worried about us and insisted on coming.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_9.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Is that so? Then our gratitude to you is even greater for your timely aid, {{Rover}}.
:{{DIcon}} I'm here to uncover a buried truth.
:{{DIcon}} We're all alive, and that's what counts.
:{{DIcon}} I wouldn't even be here if it weren't for that dragon.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_13.ogg}} '''Brant:''' To find the brightest truth, one must delve into the deepest shadows. Such bravery deserves to be hailed, my friend.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_14.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Where is everyone on the Pilgrim's Sail?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_15.ogg}} '''Brant:''' I was patrolling the coast earlier when I saw their ship drifting into the mist. Time was against us, so I departed alone without alerting the crew.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_16.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' T-thank you.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_17.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Don't be afraid. You're safe with us. You've got some skill, you know, holding your own for so long in the trial against the Tacet Discords.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_18.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' Trial? Ha, I don't buy into the Order's nonsense.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_19.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' I've worked hard all my life and stayed true to the Order's teachings about forsaking earthly pleasures for divine favor. And what do I get in return? Heavier taxes.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_20.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' When pirates ransacked my merchant fleet leaving me with nothing, I turned to the Order for help. They said it was a divine trial and left me to rot.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_21.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' I stood before the Sentinel's statue, asking if my suffering was really Their will, but all I got was... silence.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_22.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' Why should I wait for peace in the afterlife when I could be living for today? How is that a crime?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_23.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' As for salvation... I don't believe in it, and I certainly don't need it.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_24.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Here's a proposal. How about joining our troupe?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_26.ogg}} '''Brant:''' We are wanderers adrift upon the seas. Or perhaps you're more familiar with the name—the Troupe of Fools.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_27.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' The Troupe of Fools? Could it be...
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_28.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Yes. We are, like you, by the Order's decree... marked as Fools.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_29.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Fools on the Pilgrim's Sail often meet their demise in a storm or they're swallowed by the waves... Even if they do survive, they still face hunger, thirst, and the unforgiving wrath of nature.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_30.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Maybe it's luck that brought you here so swiftly, and unharmed at that.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_31.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Look around. This is all that remains of the Pilgrim's Sail... This is always their final destination, where the Fools meet their end.
:{{DIcon}} Is this the truth Carlotta spoke of?
:{{DIcon}} Is this the place Carlotta said everything ends?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_32.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Yes. The pilgrimage is nothing but a banishment in disguise. The path to salvation they speak of doesn't exist.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_35.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Otherwise, how could this once sacred place now look like such a hellish wasteland?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_39.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' Wait, sacred place? No wonder the others were talking about it on the ship. They believed the Order's promise that prayers at the Sacrificial Arena would grant them forgiveness... They must be heading up the mountain now.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_41.ogg}} '''Brant:''' I didn't expect their faith to lead them that far.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_42.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' If only they knew it was just one of the Order's lies.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_43.ogg}} '''???:''' Captain! First mate! We're here to help!
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_44.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' More hands make light work. I called in some help to escort him back to the base once the mist cleared.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_45.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Ah, the first mate's foresight is unmatched! Then the three of us can head up the mountain.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_46.ogg}} '''Brant:''' But beware my friend, by the end of this pilgrimage, you will witness the order's cruelest deceit. The dangers ahead will only intensify.
:{{DIcon}} That's what I'm here for.
:{{DIcon}} No time for doubt. Lives are at stake.
:{{DIcon}} I've got a score to settle with that dragon anyway.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_50.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' Please, save them... I hope it's not too late.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_51.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Don't worry. There's more to our troupe than you think.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_52.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' This Wingray can fly us up the mountain.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_53.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' You two go first. You'll find I'm very convenient to bring along.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_23_54.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Alright then... All hands, prepare to ascend!

:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_30_16.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Our troupe usually earns a living by performing on the nearby islands. Sometimes, we take on escort missions for merchant ships as well. That's how we first got acquainted with the Fractsidus.

:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_30_26.ogg}} '''Brant:''' At first, we thought you were merely a curious traveler, intrigued by the Carnevale and our Sentinel. But now, seeing how far you've come, there's more to your quest, isn't there?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_30_27.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Our troupe has always sought the Laurel, and we won't sit back while others threaten the Carnevale. If they're your foes, then our paths align!
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_30_28.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Remember I mentioned one of ours who once claimed the Laurel?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_30_29.ogg}} '''Brant:''' He wasn't with us when we first met. But once we reach our base, you can speak with him about the Sentinel.

::{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_18.ogg}} '''Brant:''' As the captain, it's my duty to be the crew's compass. This face must not show any fear or sorrow.
:{{DIcon}} About the Reverberations in the sea mist...
::{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_19.ogg}} '''Brant:''' This isle is fraught with hidden threats. Many who were banished never made it to join us, claimed by the Tacet Discords. Their Reverberations became part of the mist...
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_20.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Those who did make it have their own dreams to chase.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_21.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Some will eventually leave to follow the call of their hearts, their silhouettes forever etched into the mist.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_22.ogg}} '''Brant:''' We hope they find their promised lands. The troupe may be a safe harbor, but it's certainly not the final destination of their journey.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_23.ogg}} '''Brant:''' We honor their names and stories in our plays, passing their legacy down through the crew.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_24.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Beriarti the Fire Eater, Toscanini the Night Watcher, Fernando the Fish Killer... Their stories remain vivid in my memory. One day, I'll compile them into a book. Mark my words.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_25.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Over the years, we've bid farewell to many and welcomed countless new faces... It seems this cycle will never end.
:{{DIcon}} Why were you banished?
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_27.ogg}} '''Brant:''' When I was a boy, I saw the Sentinel's statue in the Cathedral of Mercury. Curiosity led me to point at the statue and ask, "How can you say it's the Sentinel when no one has ever laid eyes on it?" I didn't know the consequences that would follow.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_28.ogg}} '''Brant:''' That question earned me a pilgrimage<ref>Although it seems to be an innocent question, it is revealed in [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]] that the Sentinel's true form was that of a Pegasus, and the statues depicted Their corrupted Sea-Horse form from merging with Leviathan. Brant's question may have unknowingly struck a chord for the Order.</ref>. At the time, I thought it was some grand adventure.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_29.ogg}} '''Brant:''' On the Pilgrim's Sail, I was cared for by other Fools who shared what little they had and shielded me from the grim reality with their kindness and smiles.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_30.ogg}} '''Brant:''' But all I could do was watch... as they passed away, one by one. From that day forward, I swore to wipe away the tears of the innocent.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_31.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Every adventurer needs a rest, and every ship must find a port. For us, that meant finding a sanctuary.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_32.ogg}} '''Brant:''' When we finally reached this forsaken isle, the destination of our pilgrimage, we fought the Tacet Discords to claim our territory and scavenged what we could from the ship's wreckage. From that, we built all this...
:{{DIcon}} A remarkable achievement.
:{{DIcon}} There's something bittersweet in that.
:{{A|Vo rsmq_2_3_34_35.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Though the night may be long, the dawn always follows! That, my friend, is what we should set our sights on.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_1.ogg}} '''???:''' Relax, young man. Life's only just unfurling its sails for you. Why sit there like one of those dour statues in the Order's halls? Don't be afraid to show a little spark!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_2.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' I... I was just thinking about my future. Is Ragunna truly lost to me forever?

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_5.ogg}} '''???:''' I might be an old man now, but don't let that fool you. I was once crowned with the Laurel, you know!

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_7.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' In the flesh! Hahaha!
:{{DIcon}} Did anything unusual happen to you when you had the Laurel?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_10.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' As I took my final bow on stage, a bright light pierced through the clouds, shining down from the sky. And then, a radiant Laurel descended upon me. And I heard a voice—it was the Sentinel's voice, ringing in my head.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_11.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' I asked Them a question that had puzzled me since childhood, the ultimate philosophical riddle—"What should I eat tonight?"

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_13.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' But why Laurus Salad?<ref>It is revealed in [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]] that Cartethyia was the one speaking to the Laureates once she became a Resonator, and that she recommended the Laurus Salad because it's her favorite.</ref> I was baffled, and the meaning still eludes me to this very day. I've never been quick-witted though, and the Order's doctrines never quite took hold. Acting, however, that is where my true passion lies...
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps that's just the Sentinel's personal favorite...
:{{DIcon}} I must say, your question is rather interesting...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_17.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' But why did a blessed Laureate like you get banished by the Order?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_18.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' Back when I won the Laurel, Ragunna was led by the Holy Maiden. She promoted all sorts of grand celebrations during the Carnevale, an unceasing tide of revelry...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_19.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' Stages sprang up on every corner of the city, performances dancing through the streets, and shops adorned in vibrant hues. Even on rainy nights, you could still hear music playing in the square.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_20.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' Some performers wove their critiques into their acts. Sharp as she was, the Holy Maiden noticed. She refined city policy with each whisper of dissent.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_21.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' Ah, those were the golden days, my friend. The Holy Maiden once said that if she were to leave this world, she'd want no majestic tomb or a solemn funeral, but the grandest Carnevale as her final farewell.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_22.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' And then... she really did leave us. The current Primus took her place, and in the name of "mourning the Holy Maiden," issued all sorts of bans on the Carnevale. But is that really what she would have wanted?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_23.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' The Order's grip tightened, and the Carnevale performances were reduced to dull, monotonous shadows of their former selves.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_24.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' One year, I strung a wire from a Gondola to the top of the clock tower in Liberty Square, and another from the tower to the Fisalia's mansion.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_25.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' Then, I disguised myself as one of the La Guardia to fool the Acolytes and climbed to the roof along the wire...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_26.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' Midway through the Order's performance, I hopped on a Wingray with a Cloudcaster, showering the entire city with flowers.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_27.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Yes, it was a magnificent sight. The Wingray soared higher than the Acolytes could reach. They couldn't do anything but watch golden-pink petals rain from the sky for three whole days.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_28.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' They struggled to clean up the flowers from the streets, and it took a downpour to wash them all away. That Cloudcaster, adapted from a music van, became the prototype for the one we use on stage today.
:{{DIcon}} Exactly what I'd expect from a Laureate.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder you got banished by the Order...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_31.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' But that's all in the past! To this day, I'm still not sure what crime they pinned on me. Maybe walking the wire without protection? Ha!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_32.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' Anyway, I'm just an old relic now. But you lot, you're the main characters of this era, facing down every obstacle with fire in your bellies!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_33.ogg}} '''Andreas:''' But isn't our fate already sealed? Without the so-called "salvation" the Order preaches, we're doomed to our banishment. Just lost souls, dying in obscurity...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_34.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Life is short, and we weren't born just to atone. The Order may banish us, but they can't take away our right to sing.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_36.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Death is one of many possible ends, but it's certainly not the worst. Perhaps being forgotten is what the Order wanted for us.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_37.ogg}} '''Brant:''' They want to erase all traces of our existence, grind us into dust, and drag us into the abyss... But we'll fight the tide and live our lives to the fullest.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_39.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Members of the troupe may come and go, but they've never truly left us. Their deeds and songs are passed down through the ages.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_40.ogg}} '''Brant:''' One day, our voices will echo across every land, our words will reach every corner of the world, and by then, even the Tacet Discords in the Stormy Sea will know our names.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_38_45.ogg}} '''Bardolino:''' That's the spirit, boy! Even if I can't earn myself a proper title, I'll become Rinascita's most enigmatic legend. When I'm gone, I'll leave behind a coffin that sings, or maybe turn into a lark, singing every day and night...

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_1.ogg}} '''Brant:''' Our rehearsals are rather straightforward. No scripts, just pure intuition and our senses guiding us! That's what makes Commedia Improvviso truly come alive!
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_2.ogg}} '''Brant:''' For our improvised comedy, we start with a theme. From there, we build our lines and act on the fly, responding to the unfolding show and audience reactions.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_4.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' But with the limitless capacity for human creativity at play, the plot can sometimes veer into the... well, unconventional. To prevent things from spiraling too far, we set an "anchor" for the performance.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_5.ogg}} '''Carlotta:''' Pardon my interruption, but I'm quite curious—what sort of bizarre plots have you encountered?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_6.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Well, something like "A humble craftsman from a small town sets sail on a rainy night, stumbles upon ancient ruins, is reincarnated with super powers, and then decides to conquer the galaxy, becoming the Emperor of the Stars..."
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_7.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' So, we draft a basic outline that assigns roles and guides the plot's direction.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_8.ogg}} '''Brant:''' And this time, our outline is: "A kingdom is attacked, monsters run rampant, and the Demon King has kidnapped the Holy Maiden. A few brave heroes accept the minister's quest to defeat the Demon King and rescue her."
:{{DIcon}} A real classic, no doubt.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds a bit cliché...
:{{DIcon}} So, a classic adventure story.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_12.ogg}} '''Brant:''' This outline holds special meaning. We want to pay tribute to the play once performed by the Blessed Maiden herself, which was also about a hero facing a Demon King.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_13.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' Good people have their wishes fulfilled, heroes appear in a time of crisis, justice triumphs over evil, and united friends are undefeatable.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_14.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' This is the tale the Blessed Maiden once told, and it's a universal story we want to portray.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_16.ogg}} '''Brant:''' To me, the world is a stage, and performing is much like combat. Coordinated movements, quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and, above all, trust in your allies.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_40_17.ogg}} '''Brant:''' What I'm getting at is that you both are very skilled and capable. We don't have many dos and don'ts, so relax and express yourselves freely on stage!

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_204_2.ogg}} '''Carlotta:''' Once, the Blessed Maiden was just a simple peasant girl. During the Sentinel's Gratitude Rite, the young Fleurdelys managed to sneak past the guards and drink the sacramental wine—every drop.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_27.ogg}} '''Carlotta:''' Remember [[Gilberto]], from the Fisalia family? It took a lot to get him to talk, but we finally got some information from him.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_28.ogg}} '''Carlotta:''' As he tells it, the Fisalia family's long-revered deity is none other than... [[Leviathan]], the Threnodian from the sea's depths.
:{{DIcon}} They worship the Threnodian...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_30.ogg}} '''Carlotta:''' It's hard to believe, I know. But recent events have only reinforced what we discovered from the stained glass.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_31.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' The Fisalia family has been on this island since the founding of Rinascita, so their worship of the Threnodian may have persisted for centuries.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_32.ogg}} '''Carlotta:''' We will attempt to establish contact with the Fisalias to build an alliance and gather more intelligence.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_34.ogg}} '''Carlotta:''' Rest assured, negotiation is what we do best. If necessary, we'll present them with an offer they can't refuse.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_37.ogg}} '''Brant:''' How curious. Since when has the Primus become so interested in social calls?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_73_38.ogg}} '''Roccia:''' It could very well be a trap.

;(Go to the Cathedral of Mercury)
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_47.ogg}} '''???:''' Never before have I seen a day so steeped in both shadow and light.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_48.ogg}} '''???:''' The birds sing, the flowers bloom... yet this world knows neither true joy nor eternity.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_3.ogg}} '''???:''' Come closer, Righteous One, there's no need for hesitation.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_4.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' I am Fenrico, the Primus of the Order of the Deep. Your deeds have reached my ears, and I have long wished to meet you. Alas, the burdens of this world delayed our meeting until now. I beg your pardon for the wait.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_5.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Please accept my respect for you—you and your troupe have shown great talent and ambition, breathing new life into Ragunna.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_6.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' I ask you to deliver this message to your companions: from this day forth, the troupe shall have permanent rights to perform within the city.
:{{DIcon}} I surely will.
:{{DIcon}} Even if they're all Fools?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_9.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' All mortals stumble, but through pilgrimage, they have cleansed their souls and atoned for their transgressions. They have earned their right to return to this divinely blessed land.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_10.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' I understand that questions weigh on your heart. In the presence of a just Divinity, speak freely, and I will answer with all the honesty I possess.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_11.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' By the great Sentinel Imperator, I swear to you. There shall be no deceit in my words.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} I want to meet the Sentinel Imperator.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_13.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' You have walked a path similar to Theirs. Indeed, you have the right to meet Them.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_14.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' However, due to the Dark Tide two decades ago, the Sentinel's body was gravely wounded and remains in a state of recovery.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_15.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' If you wish to meet Them, I will convey your request.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_16.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' I see the thirst for truth in your eyes. It is clear that doubts still linger in your heart. Please, voice your concerns.
:{{DIcon}} Tell me about the Blessed Fleurdelys.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_18.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Fleurdelys... She was the emissary of the Sentinel, and we are grateful for her contributions.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_19.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Twenty years ago, during the Dark Tide, she sacrificed herself to seal the calamity. She fulfilled her duties in this world and returned to the <span style="color:#f9fd0a;">'''divine embrace'''</span>.
:{{DIcon}} Returned to the divine embrace?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_21.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Do you know how the Dark Tide came into being?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_22.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' In Rinascita, wars were waged in the name of faith, tearing apart the Sentinel as our faith divided, weakening Their divine power.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_23.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' The Dark Tide's true essence is the divine blood shed from the Sentinel's wounds.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_24.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' That tragic past left deep scars, and with Their divine power drained, They could not prevent the Dark Tide's surge twenty years ago.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_25.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' The Blessed Maiden chose to martyr herself. She <span style="color:#f9fd0a;">'''once again'''</span> resonated with the Sentinel and, through her sacrifice, restored some of Their divine power, bringing an end to the Dark Tide.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_26.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Yet, the Sentinel remains in a state of healing and still requires a mortal representative. Following the Blessed Maiden's departure, I was granted new authority to cleanse the aftermath of the Dark Tide.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_27.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' I received the Divinity's blessing and became the new Enlightened One. By Their will, I fulfill the tasks left unfinished in this world.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_28.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Therefore, we must unify all beliefs, ensuring the purity and unity of our will to prevent another tragedy...
:{{DIcon}} (Reflect on the Blessed Maiden's Second Resonance with the Sentinel.)
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_30_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_30_F.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (He said she "once again resonated with the Sentinel," was that really a Second Resonance Awakening? Sentinel Jué had a trial with Jinhsi, but my permission was needed to transfer the Sentinel's power...)
:{{DIcon}} You're hiding things from me.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_33.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' I swear, my words are without deceit.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_34.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' I see in your eyes that you have walked further on the path of justice than I anticipated.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_35.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' O dear Sentinel... please forgive my transgressions.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_36.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' The Dark Tide brought us a bloodstained lesson. To keep our people from faltering, I bound myself to silence, locking away what I witnessed on that fateful day.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_38.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Fleurdelys, the Unrighteous, deceived us all. She was not the Blessed Maiden chosen by the Sentinel... The true maiden has yet to reveal herself.
:{{DIcon}} Why did people believe she was the Blessed Maiden?
:{{DIcon}} Where did her power to seal the Dark Tide come from?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_41.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' You must know that a being capable of rivaling our Divinity exists in this world—humanity's eternal adversary, the evil of all civilizations... the Threnodian.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_42.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' As the Sentinel has Their Resonator, so does the Threnodian.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_44.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Fleurdelys was shaped—both body and spirit—by our ancient enemy. Her actions were intended to plunge this city into fear and chaos.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_69_45.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' This is the truth I witnessed—Fleurdelys was the <span style="color:#f9fd0a;">'''Threnodian's Resonator'''</span>.

:{{DIcon|Option}} Why do you banish people in the name of pilgrimage?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_7.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' We must create a land that aligns with the Sentinel's vision. We must purge this land of individuals who stray from the righteous path to ensure that our collective will remains unified and pure.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_8.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' However, we honor the deeds of Napoli II, the founding Primus, and offer those who have strayed a chance for atonement.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_9.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' The Pilgrim's Sail follows Napoli's path. He too once endured this arduous journey, yet emerged victorious, earning an audience with the Sentinel.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_10.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' The trials are not mere sufferings but steps toward redemption. The penitent who confront the trials with sincerity will be allowed to return to the divine's embrace.
:{{DIcon|Option}} Why do you oppose the Carnevale?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_11.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Unity is our shield, bound by the law of eternal continuity.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_12.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' Though we revel in the joy of the Carnevale, we must also be vigilant.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_13.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' For division is a chronic disease plaguing this city. The growing indulgence among our citizens has already invited divine punishment.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_14.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' We, as stewards of divine will, must guide the people, erecting barriers of reason against the floods of passion. This is the only way to withstand the ever-changing tides.
:{{DIcon|Option}} Why did you work with the Fractsidus?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_15.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' We uphold the Sentinel's principles of justice. The gates to our divine land remain open to all who seek it.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_16.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' This is a city of inclusiveness, welcoming all visitors... including those who try to overstep their bounds.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_17.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' These charlatans misled our people with lies and flattery, diverting them from the divine will.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_18.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' But your timely intervention corrected their course, sparing them from a ruinous fate. Once again, I offer my sincerest gratitude.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} That's it for now.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_75_19.ogg}} '''Fenrico:''' May the Divinity bless you, and may you always walk the path of righteousness.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_1.ogg}} '''???:''' Phrolova, you do have a knack for indulging in... pointless little chores.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_2.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Why, there's no rule against an actor making good use of the intermission.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_3.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Besides, I haven't disrupted your arrangement, have I?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_4.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' "The one from a faraway land who discerns the truth dares to raise their sword against the divine. In response, the slumbering gods break free from their shackles, revealing their true forms..."
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_5.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' The possibility of the Second Resonance Awakening is now a certainty. So we just need to see if that special Resonator truly exists.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_6.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Was the Blessed Maiden a Resonator for the Sentinel or the Threnodian?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_7.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Or both? If so... Oh, a Resonator capable of wielding both powers... I am eager to see how this story ends.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_8.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Cristoforo, if you don't want to spoil the next act, I might have to give your carefully crafted plot a little nudge.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_9_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_9_F.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Speaking of which, {{Rover}} shines brighter than anyone else in your play. Do you find {{MC|m=him|f=her}} interesting as well?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_10.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Phrolova, it seems we walk different paths. I don't share your fondness for that sort of... puppet theater.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_11.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' I merely place the characters on their stage and they act out their fates, driven by their own volition.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_12.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' To remain courageous amidst absurdity, to pursue a spark of divine grace—this, to me, is the truest essence of humanity, don't you think?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_13.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Even the most pristine cadence of death pales beside the untamed, fervent, and tenacious spirits of the living.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_14.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' In their journey, they resolutely overcome all obstacles: they pursue, they tear, they burn—simply because they desire to.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_15.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' I think you should leave your secluded mansion. Take a walk and listen to the voices scattered across the world.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_16.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' ...Perhaps.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_17_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_17_F.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' From Huanglong to Rinascita, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} has indeed added a few unexpectedly beautiful notes to my symphony.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_18_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_18_F.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' I am certain that, even without any direction, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} will walk the path that destiny has laid before {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_19.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' All things ascend towards a singular point of convergence, and what awaits at the end is... immortality.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_20.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' Before the tides of fate, we are all but...
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_3_70_21.ogg}} '''Cristoforo:''' ...humble servants.
